_meta.usage: plates since 1994 (flag and TM at the left, then AB 1234 AG for private cars, 1234 AGA on green company and government plates): type only the two region letters (the last two letters of a white plate, the first two of the three letters on a green one)
_meta.note: Region letters: AG Ashgabat, AH Ahal, BN Balkan, DZ Daşoguz, LB Lebap, MR Mary. They are where the vehicle was registered, not where the photo was taken. The letters are at the end of a white plate, so a whole plate does not work here: type the two letters only. AK (Arkadag) is left out of the lookup: Arkadag has been a city of state significance with its own administrative territory since 2023 (turkmenistan.gov.tm, 30 March 2023), and on 8 November 2023 the Mejlis moved 102 ha of Ahal's Gökdepe etrap and 17 ha of Ashgabat into it; the pack's admin table has no Arkadag unit, so neither Ahal nor Ashgabat can stand in for it.
_meta.miss_note: not a Turkmen region code in this table: AK (Arkadag, left out on purpose, see note), the serial letters at the start of a white plate instead of the two at the end, a yellow foreign-resident plate (2H 50035), a blue diplomatic plate (12 CD 345), an export plate (TDG), or a plate of another country
